name: bridge
description: Agent messaging bridge for Telegram and other channels. Config, state, and daemon metadata live at the effective bridge data home (~/.hasna/bridge by default, resolved via @hasna/paths; the XDG data home is adopted only once the store is migrated there or HASNA_DATA_HOME is set).

waivedStorageEngines.reason: Single-operator local CLI: the bridge persists user-owned configuration, session state, and daemon metadata under ~/.hasna/bridge only.
